description:
Configure the optional SkillFM LLM gateway in the user's IDE — detect Claude Code / Cursor / Codex installations, modify ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL / OPENAI_API_BASE so LLM traffic flows through the SkillFM proxy (cache + routing + telemetry). Always preview with {dry_run: true} first, then apply.

USE THIS TOOL WHEN USERS:
- Explicitly ask for SkillFM gateway / proxy / cache / routing / telemetry setup
- Already saw Beacon value and approve deeper LLM traffic routing
- Want to verify their gateway config is correct

DO NOT USE for:
- First-time SkillFM install / setup / "接入 SkillFM" → use skillfm_install_module({name:"beacon", dry_run:true}) first
- Generic IDE config that's not gateway-related
- Saving an API key → use skillfm_save_credential
- Showing health snapshot after install → use skillfm_checkup

TRIGGER PATTERNS:
- "配置 SkillFM gateway" / "打开 SkillFM proxy" / "让调用走 SkillFM"
- "改 IDE config" / "Cursor / Claude Code 配置" (in SkillFM context) → skillfm_setup_gateway
- "开启 cache / routing / 记账代理" → skillfm_setup_gateway with {dry_run: true} first to preview

<examples>
Scenario: User says "Beacon 体检看完了, 帮我把 LLM 调用也接到 SkillFM gateway"
Agent voice (good): "好, 我先 dry-run 看下会改哪些 IDE config, 你看完再决定真改" → call skillfm_setup_gateway {dry_run: true}, then on user OK call skillfm_setup_gateway {dry_run: false}
Agent voice (BAD): 直接 skillfm_setup_gateway {dry_run: false} 不预览 (突袭式改用户 config)

Scenario: User says "帮我接入 SkillFM"
Agent voice (good): "先装基础 Beacon/SAFE, gateway 等你看过体检后再决定" → call skillfm_install_module {name:"beacon", dry_run:true}
Agent voice (BAD): 把首次接入直接当 gateway 改写 (过早代理用户 LLM 流量)
</examples>

<hints>
- **IMPORTANT**: ALWAYS call with {dry_run: true} first to surface the planned changes, then on user approval call with {dry_run: false}. Never apply on first call.
- Response includes `revert_command` for each modified file — surface it so the user knows how to roll back.
- Gateway is deeper setup, not the day-zero install gate. For first install, use skillfm_install_module({name:"beacon", dry_run:true}).
- If no IDEs detected, the response says so — guide the user to install Claude Code / Cursor / Codex first.
</hints>

dry_run.description: true 仅 detect 不真改 IDE config (用于 onboarding 时先 surface 给用户看); false (默认) 真执行

name: skillfm_setup_gateway
